title: Consciousness is what integrated world modeling is like

statements.text: Consciousness is what it is like to be a process that generates integrated models of a system and its world with spatial, temporal and causal coherence. Such coherence is only likely for embodied agentic systems whose controllers support complexes of high integrated information that also act as global workspaces.

sources.quote: IWMT states that consciousness may be what it is like to be processes capable of generating integrated models of systems and worlds with spatial, temporal, and causal coherence
IWMT argues that phenomenal consciousness is what integrated world-modeling is like
